messages:
maya_g: Heads-up — release v2.14.0 is blocked by a recurring staging e2e failure. Looks like a DB fixture namespace collision when tests run in parallel.
samir: Ugh. Saw a few flakes in the pipeline too. Is this the same `orders` schema collision from last month?
qa_ci: Repro steps: run `./ci/run-e2e --parallel=6` on staging. Failure snippet:
```
ERROR: create_schema orders_temp_42 failed: schema already exists
stack: tests/e2e/orders_test.py:47 -> fixtures/db.py:23
```
qa_ci: Happens ~1/3 runs when runners pick the same ephemeral name.
deploy-bot: deploy v2.14.0-canary started at 1712345680
deploy-bot: canary healthcheck failed, rolling back to previous image
leo: Can we temporarily pin the e2e job to `--parallel=1` or add unique suffix based on runner id? Quickest unblock is serializing tests.
maya_g: pinning to serial will slow the smoke window. We need a decision: hold release or pin canary to last-good image.
toni_pm: Product prefers holding rather than releasing with flaky tests. Users rely on this cut.
samir: Option A: pin canary to image sha abc123 (last green) and hold v2.14.0 promotion. Option B: patch fixture to use k8s pod UID in name, patch in test harness (fast), then rerun.
leo: Patch looks small, but requires QA run and maybe another canary. ETA ~2-3 hours.
maya_g: For immediate unblock, let's pin canary to abc123 and block auto-promote. Samir/Toni, agree?
toni_pm: Agree. Hold promo and update release notes accordingly.
samir: I pushed a temporary job override to CI to pin canary: `IMAGE_SHA=abc123` on the promo pipeline.
qa_ci: Re-run queued e2e with the patch branch to verify; will report in ~30m.
deploy-bot: promo blocked by human hold (tag: manual-pin) at 1712345775
maya_g: Action items: (1) samir to open small PR for fixture name -> use `${POD_UID}` suffix, (2) qa_ci to confirm fast patch on staging, (3) leo to keep release window held until green.
samir: PR #4321 created, adding test to assert unique schema names. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/4321
qa_ci: First run of patched branch looks good so far, no collisions after 10 runs. I'll keep running stress for 1 hour.
maya_g: Thanks. We'll keep the promo pinned and reconvene in 1h or when QA gives green.
leo: Noted. I'll add a short note to release channel and update release docs.
maya_g: tagging @deploy-bot for audit
deploy-bot: note recorded: promo held by manual-pin (reason: staging e2e DB fixture collision)
